column1: This is the pulpit from which Sgt. Dooley delivers his words of wisdom and inspiration to his troops. Listen and take careful notes during each briefing.
column2: 這是 Dooley 警佐向部下傳授智慧與鼓舞士氣的講台。每次簡報都要仔細聽並做筆記。

column1: The pigeonhole is a police officer's mailbox. He can receive love letters, subpoenas, nasty messages, and even departmental memos. You ought to check yours.
column2: 信件格是警員的郵箱，裡面可能有情書、傳票、討厭的留言，甚至警局備忘錄。你應該查看自己的。

column1: It's just an everyday, run-of-the-mill, rosewood, report-writing table with four legs, three drawers, and 243 pieces of gum stuck underneath.
column2: 這只是一張普通的玫瑰木報告桌，有四條腿、三個抽屜，底下還黏著 243 塊口香糖。

column1: It's a regular blackboard, but Dooley keeps all his chalk and erasers locked up so you can't leave any cute messages.
column2: 這是普通黑板，但 Dooley 把粉筆和板擦都鎖起來了，所以你留不了可愛的留言。

column1: You see nothing special about this drawer.
column2: 你沒在這個抽屜裡看到任何特別的東西。

column1: There's nothing on the podium that opens.
column2: 講台上沒有能打開的東西。

column1: You open the drawer and observe various tools used in diagraming traffic collisions. Nothing here will aid you.
column2: 你打開抽屜，看見各種繪製交通事故示意圖的工具。這裡沒有能幫上你的東西。
